slides.title: Cover
slides.notes:
> Wait until everyone is looking at the screen.

Tonight's story is about a lamp.

Who do you think lit it, every night, for forty years?

slides.title: The storm
slides.notes:
One winter night, the wind was so strong
that the windows sang.

And the lamp went out.

slides.title: Morning
slides.notes:
In the morning, the keeper found a small boat on the beach,
and a child asleep inside it.

The lamp had gone out —
but someone had kept a candle burning in the window.

slides.title: The end
slides.notes: > Press play when everyone is looking. Say nothing until the song ends.
